title: Enfamil Gentlease Infant Formula, Powder, Made with Baby Water

content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Gentlease is an infant formula powder designed for babies from birth to 12 months. It combines partially hydrolyzed proteins, probiotics, and an optimal balance of fats, carbohydrates, and vitamins. Preparation uses specially purified baby water, ensuring a consistent and safe composition.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Gentlease contains partially hydrolyzed proteins, which reduce the likelihood of colic and gas in infants.
The formula is enriched with pre‑biotics (FOS) that support the growth of beneficial gut bacteria.
It includes DHA and ARA – essential fatty acids for brain and eye development.
The product has undergone clinical trials confirming its hypoallergenic properties.
Each container yields about 800 ml of ready‑to‑feed formula, convenient for home use.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed proteins and pre‑biotics help reduce colic, gas, and constipation.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA promote neuronal connections and visual function.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, E and zinc strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Optimal growth
items.content: Balanced proteins, fats, and carbs provide the calories needed for healthy growth.

items.title: Hypoallergenic
items.content: Hydrolyzed proteins lower the risk of allergic reactions in sensitive babies.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Despite hydrolysis, some infants may still react to casein or whey.

items.title: Incorrect reconstitution
items.content: Over‑concentrated formula can strain kidneys; overly diluted formula may not meet energy needs.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: If the container is not kept dry, the powder can absorb moisture and spoil.

items.title: Lactose content
items.content: The formula contains lactose; infants with lactose intolerance need an alternative.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the specified amount of powder with pre‑warmed (about 37 °C) baby water. Stir thoroughly until smooth, let stand for 1–2 minutes, then check temperature before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry powder in its original packaging in a cool, dry place away from direct light. Use within 30 days after opening. Prepared formula can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours and should be warmed to room temperature before feeding.
